Description.SourceString:
There are those who spend years studying the magic of druids, to try and find a way to bend nature to their will. They go on long pilgrimages, solve complicated riddles and have arduous conversations with nature spirits about the fundamentals of reality. 

They needn't have bothered. For, you see, there are already those who understand how to reshape the land to serve them. People who cultivate rows of plants, each of them focused on providing food, medicine or some other benefit to their agricultural master. The farmer may be the greatest nature wizard in all of Gielinor, though they need never utter a single spell. 

This hat was once worn by the farmers of Bramblemead as a sign of their status. It was created by one Abigail Potterington, age 6, who had been taught the basics of embroidery by her mother, who had been taught it by her mother, and she by her mother and so on. The flower was said to represent a great towering oak – Abigail was not good at art.
